parameters.content:
## Queue Health API

Read-only. Feeds the alarm page on port 8081 and `scripts/watch-queue.sh`.

**Operator-facing only.** nginx serves this on 8081, which must stay off the guest VLAN — survivors reach port 80 and nothing else. It exposes counts, never message content.

Execution logging is off for success: this is polled every few seconds and would otherwise bury real intake executions in the n8n log.

parameters.query: SELECT h.*, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('reason', reason, 'n', n) ORDER BY n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT reason, count(*) AS n FROM review_pile GROUP BY reason) rp) AS review_reasons FROM queue_health h

nodes.name: Read Queue Health
nodes.notes: Reads the queue_health view and a breakdown of review_pile reasons.
